x: Walker was our first man home in sixth place and he did well seeing the calibre of the lads who finished in front of him, including the Pirie brothers, Chataway of Walton, who won the recent South of Thames event, Brown of Mitcham who was runner-up in the National Youth's race, and Green of Reading…

The race was run over our usual five-mile course, except that owing to weather conditions it was decided to "cut out" the crossing of Beverley Brook. In the circumstances the time recorded by the winner, Ray Tooby, was very good indeed, and D.
The Surrey event was held at Petersham from the Ranelagh H. quarters, and our team was weakened by the absence of D.

I am sure that our senior team would be the first to say how much the help and encouragement of the few Belgrave supporters, who were able to give information on the progress of rival teams, nearly helped them to pull off a surprise win, and maybe with a few more members present at crucial points on…

Basil Walden sustained a damaged shoulder while playing “rugger” for Streatham recently, and we trust that the injury will not affect his track prospects this summer. We have quite a “school” of Club members now at London University and these include Reg Bolam, Colin Collis, D.
